product.name: Press
product.tagline: The brand system your clients can't break.
taglineAlternates: Design it once. Let them run with it.
On-brand, without you in the room.
Where brand systems go to stay alive.
product.descriptionShort: Press is a white-label brand studio: designers lock the system — templates, type, color, photography — and clients create, compose, and publish inside it. On-brand, every time.

features.name: Locked templates
features.short: Templates where only the right things are editable.
features.long: The designer decides what moves: this line is a field, this mark is pinned, this image is the photo slot. The team fills in the blanks — they can't stretch the logo, can't move the type, can't break the grid.

features.name: Brand Kit, down to the letter-spacing
features.short: Palette, named text styles, photo libraries — the system, live in the tool.
features.long: Named text styles carry font, size, color, leading and tracking, with live previews; they surface as one-click presets in the editor. The client's photography lives in curated libraries. Even the interface wears the brand: Press × their mark.

features.name: Create a post
features.short: Describe the post. Press finds the photo and sets the type.
features.long: Press looks through the client's own photo library — with vision, never stock — picks the shot that fits, writes the copy in the brand voice, and composes the layout.

features.name: Content Studio
features.short: Paste a month of notes. Get a month of drafts.
features.long: A content dump goes in; Press reads it against the client's templates and drafts a batch of on-brand posts, each a starting point a human approves.

features.name: Recreate from a screenshot
features.short: A Figma export goes in. An editable template comes out.
features.long: Press reverse-engineers a flat JPG — exact copy, closest fonts, colors, shapes, photo regions — into editable layers, with the original as a tracing overlay.

features.name: Publish from the same room
features.long: Design it, caption it, schedule it. Press publishes directly to Instagram and Facebook, carousels included, on the client's calendar.

features.name: A real editor underneath
features.short: Version history, smart guides, background removal, duotones.
features.long: A thirty-step visual history you can scrub, smart guides, out-of-frame ghosts, one-click background removal, brand duotones, and full typographic control.

features.name: Every client, one roof
features.short: Multi-client by design — each brand its own world.
features.long: Each client gets its own templates, brand kit, photo libraries, AI voice, and publishing connections — and the interface re-dresses itself per client.

caseStudy.premise: A fictional small-batch tea shop in Logan Square, built inside Press to show the full arc: system → creation → publishing.

beats.title: We built their brand into the tool itself.
Three templates, locked where it counts.
A month of mornings, drafted in one.
Published from the same room it was designed in.

caseStudy.closing: Press is what a brand system looks like when it's alive: the designer sets it, the client runs it, and nothing off-brand ever leaves the building.
